ev.q: In metropolitan counties, infant mortality rates were highest for infants of non-Hispanic Black mothers (10.60 infant deaths per 1,000 live births)
In nonmetropolitan counties, the mortality rate was also highest for infants of non-Hispanic Black mothers (10.85)
differences in rates between metropolitan and nonmetropolitan counties for infants of non-Hispanic Black and non-Hispanic Asian mothers were not statistically significant
significantly lower for infants of non-Hispanic White, non-Hispanic American Indian or Alaska Native, and Hispanic mothers in metropolitan counties
Source: National Vital Statistics System. Linked Birth and Infant Death Data
